summary: Wilco 63 Corp filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 23,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment, for gross proceeds of $230 million. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-half of one redeemable warrant. The filing also details entry into underwriting, warrant, and letter agreements. This is a routine IPO closing report, not a special situation event. The Cayman Islands issuer is a blank-check company post-IPO, with no current acquisition target, activist campaign, or restructuring announced.
